messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: GPU_PREFILL_OOM detected on infer-pool-7. 12 container restarts in last 6m, affected nodes: node-7a,node-7b. Severity: P1. Paging oncall-ops. https://incidents.redwood.example/4781239999 :rotating_light:
oncall-ops: on it. Acked. jumping in, collecting quicksight dashboards and recent deploys.
sre-alyssa: seeing repeated SIGKILLs in kube events for pods on node-7a. probable OOM during prefill when large-context requests hit the model. grabbing logs now.
runtime-josh: logs show CUDA out-of-memory during prefill sequences. sample from pod infer-7a-210: 
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 6.00 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 24.10 GiB already allocated; 1.25 GiB free; 25.12 GiB reserved)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/serve/runner.py", line 412, in _prefill
    kv_cache.alloc(...)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/cuda/memory.py", line 123, in allocate
    raise RuntimeError('CUDA OOM')
```

runtime-josh: also seeing occasional `CUDA kernel launch failed` before restarts. seems like large-window prefill (>=120k tokens) + batch concurrency causes mem explosion.
eng-ml-sam: which model variant? are these requests pinned to larger context model?
sre-alyssa: traffic shows mixed clients, but a spike from tenant: giftex-api with multiple long-chat sessions. they compose multi-segment context ~200k tokens.
infra-nick: node metrics: GPU mem pressure hits 99% then OOM, kill, pod restart, then cascade when others get scheduled back on same node. nodes not being cordoned automatically.
oncall-ops: immediate mitigations: 1) enable emergency routing to smaller-context variant (coldmodel) 2) throttle/limit max prompt tokens per-route for affected pool 3) cordon node-7a and drain gracefully 4) set rollout to reduce concurrency on infer-pool-7. who can flip routing?
eng-ml-sam: I can flip model routing to the -shortctx variant for that customer route. preparing canary change now.
runtime-josh: also rolling a hotfix to disable aggressive prefetch of KV for sequences > 64k as a safety net. deploying to a single node first.
customer-success-maya: customer-facing: giftex flagged 503s ~6m ago. can we get ETA for mitigation before I DM customers?
oncall-ops: cordon started node-7a -> draining pods off node-7a now (kubectl drain). ETA ~2-4m. routing flip expected in ~90s once canary finishes.
sre-alyssa: applying temporary iptable rate-limits to drop >120k token requests into infer-pool-7 to reduce new prefill pressure. quick patch: `redwoodctl routes patch --pool=infer-pool-7 --max_prompt_tokens=120000`
infra-nick: side note: autoscaler tried to spin new nodes but hit AZ quota, will follow up post-incident.
eng-ml-sam: routing flip done for giftex route to -shortctx variant. watching.
runtime-josh: hotfix deployed to 1/4 nodes, no regression so far. prefill failures dropped on canary.
oncall-ops: draining complete for node-7a, pods rescheduled. watching restart churn.
sre-alyssa: restart rate dropping from ~2.3/min to 0.4/min since routing and cordon. good sign.
customer-success-maya: relayed to Giftex support: we're actively mitigating, temporary routing to shorter-context model and throttling long requests. will update in 5m.
eng-ml-sam: postmortem actions we'll track: 1) add circuit-breaker for >100k token prefill that routes to fallback model; 2) implement per-tenant long-context fair-queueing; 3) improve autoscaler quota alerts; 4) add OOM kernel tracing.
runtime-josh: follow-up hotfix: add background KV cache eviction for long-lived sequences to prevent cumulative allocation. pushing PR now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (routing flip, node cordon, prefill throttle). customer impact reduced. paging will stand down after 30m of stability.
oncall-ops: standing down pager to watch-only in 30m unless churn resumes. thanks everyone. :heart:
